summary.tldr: Adds public transit workers to the Criminal Code rule that treats assault against them as an aggravating factor at sentencing.
what_it_does: Replaces Criminal Code section 269.01 to require courts to treat assault against a public transit worker as an aggravating factor when sentencing the listed offences.
Defines public transit to mean passenger transportation service provided to the public, including paratransit and school bus services.
summary.background: The bill replaces section 269.01 of the Criminal Code. It expands the aggravating circumstance from public transit operators to all public transit workers.
